bestBets.overview: JUNIPER couldn't have been much more impressive on debut where she parked off the speed and powered away from her rivals late. If she repeats that effort she wins again. VIENNA CALLING has ability and is a horse on the rise. CAWARRA rolls forward and gives a sight. SPANISH ARMADA next best.

raceTips.comment:
Not sure JUNIPER beat too much on debut but the way this 3yo filly did so was impressive on a Heavy 9 track down at Northam. Not the strongest C1 you will find and a great opportunity to see how she measures up on a Wednesday.
VIENNA CALLING went around a $3.60 chance 14 days ago and ran behind some nice enough types who I'm giving excuses for at each of their next race starts. 
ARTIES STORM will appreciate dropping back to the 1200m but will have SPANISH ARMADA for company throughout.
Dont discount CHOUXNWISKEY - you are getting a price for a horse who has shown some ability and was in the wrong part of the track at Bunbury - though a Maiden into a C1 is never a recipe for sustained success

JUNIPER could not have been more impressive on debut a fortnight ago. She settled near last over 1000m and was far too good for her maiden rivals, sprinting clear by an extending near 3L margin. At this time of year the 3 year old fillies taking on the older horses get a big age allowance and so she only rises half a kilo to 55.5 and has far more upside (and ability) than her rivals. Expect she’ll safely account for these. SPANISH ARMADA looks the danger. He breezed and won at Northam by a similar margin to Juniper and then went straight into a Westspeed Platinum where he met with a lot of support in betting. It was a leaders/fence day and he flopped, but 1200m and C1 company both look suitable. VIENNA CALLING is always there abouts. CAWARRA tries hard but is no star.

bestBets.overview: CHATTA VISION makes his debut on the back of a fast finishing runner-up effort at his only trial. If he can make use of his good draw and settle within striking distance then expecting him to be hard to hold out. OFFICIAL BUSINESS was well supported in the betting first-up and was narrowly beaten after  wanting to lay inwards in the straight. If he races more tractably he goes close. OUR MANE MAN ran well first-up where he finished a close-up second behind a subsequent Saturday winner. JEMCONI next best.

raceTips.comment: OFFICIAL BUSINESS trialled as well as now Saturday winning filly Gaintree before resuming on a Heavy9 at Northam. Looked all at sea and ran around like a drunken sailor in the home straight. Hopefully onto a Soft5/Soft6 he is more comfortable and can go a bit straighter for Chris Parnham. OUR MAIN MAN was resuming off only a 400m jump out when running second to Truly Loyal in a high rating maiden. With Truly Loyal heading to a 60+ Graduation on the weekend and winning the form stands out and if he can take natural improvement first-up to second-up then he’ll be right in the mix. CHATTA VISION comes through a very slowly run 4yo+ trial (and wore visors) but did still catch the eye with a sustained run from the back of the field. Watch on debut. XELCIMUS has been her own worst enemy throughout a career littered with bad luck stories and excuses.

WINTER BLOOM likely goes around each way odds here and she drops 4.5kg and a furlong on last start where she was outclassed in a 3yo plate. Prior starts was beaten by progressive horses in The Rocket and Flying Maradona. Nice placement.
OFFICIAL BUSINESS went around short at Northam but probably didnt appreciate the Heavy 9 conditions first up. Can improve here today.
CHATTA VISION was an eye catching trial and maps to sit behind the pace beautifully here.
XELCIMUS closed off well first up and Fiore takes the ride today.

bestBets.overview: MR MELLON makes his debut on the back of a couple of sharp trial efforts. Expecting him to park midfield and find the line strongly. GUNNING FOR GOLD ran well on debut and should appreciate the rise in trip. CALL ME INVINCBLE wasn't beaten far last time out despite not getting the best of luck in transit. From his inside draw he should get a soft run and go close. SPIRIT OF AMELIA makes his debut on the back of a couple of soft trial efforts.

raceTips.comment: GUNNING FOR GOLD comes through the Star Marini / Official Business race which is on show in Race 2. His trial prior to making his debut was strong, when he worked his way through heavy traffic under little riding and the way he hit the line on debut suggests that there’s a level of ability there. Drops 1.5kg with the Nottle claim, draws better and will be eachway. WESTERN PHOENIX and SECOND DRAFT both come through the same recent Lark Hill trial on 24 August (a strong/deep trial including Moose) and both look likely to get similar runs on race day to what they enjoyed at trials. CALL ME INVINCIBLE is now an 11 start maiden. There’s no doubting he’s racing well running third to now C1 winner Espresso Time and second to Gloranardo before running fourth to Truly Loyal and Our Main Man, but will barrier 1 be any help? And has he had his chances? Willing to risk as favourite.

GUNNING FOR GOLD trialled up well prior to striking a Heavy 9 down at Northam. Happy to be forgiving of that run and we get each way in a wide open race.
SECOND DRAFT seemed to show a little at the trials for the potent combination. 
CALL ME INVINCIBLE is now an 11 start maiden but is knocking on the door and WESTERN PHOENIX comes through the same trial as SECOND DRAFT.

bestBets.overview: STAR MARTINI shook her maiden with a last start all the way maiden win. She will likely fire to the front again and prove hard to rundown. SUPERSMASH is another impressive last start maiden winner with claims. She just needs some luck from her wide draw. MON VISAGE led and battled away solidly on debut. SPIRIT OF BELLE next best.

raceTips.comment: STAR MARTINI and SUPERSMASH are both last start Northam maiden winners who like to jump and run. These 3 year old 0MWLY races are compressed (and high) weight races so they’ll both rise 4kg respectively to carry the highest weights of their short careers to date. Wary about getting too involved in horses and races like this but ultimately they’ll still carry less weight than the maiden/debutante geldings. Being drawn inside makes it advantage STAR MARTINI. MON VISAGE made her debut at 1200m and fought on well behind Hot Chix Lane. If they overcook it she might be the strongest/toughest late. She can park and ride on the leaders.

KUTE AS KAN BE and STAR MARTINI will be your two leaders with SUPERSMASH looking to come over to join them. KUTE will need to turn around an 11 length deficit on STAR MARTINI from last start where everything went wrong. Think they will scamper along here and thats why I've ended up on MON VISAGE. Out of a 1200m debut only beaten half a length, should settle right behind the speedsters and get her chance.
SPIRIT OF BELLE will looking to do the exact same. Thinking that Brad may be forced to go through the cutaway which this season has not been the place to take your run.
STAR MARTINI has returned in good form for the Taylor yard, has to carry an extra 4kg for its win at Northam and may not get all the favours out in front.
KUTE AS KAN BE was putting together some nice form prior to last starts failure on a Heavy 9.

bestBets.overview: KING'S DRAMA worked home well first-up in a better grade of race than this. He improves off that run and will appreciate the drop in grade. LAST STYLEBENDER is another class dropper. He will likely find the front and be hard to rundown. YAMASHITA'S GOLD has run well in both his local starts. BOSISTO next best.

raceTips.comment:
Difficult race to have confidence in. LAST STYLEBENDER, BRINSON and SNIP OF ROMANCE will go forward and that leaves the booking of Pike on YAMASHITA'S GOLD to play the stalking role.
He's returned in good order for the big Dyl Bairstow yard - running the fastest L600 and second fastest L400 and L200 on the card at Northam and then drew B1 on a Heavy 9 at Northam. Not ideal. Want to see Pike bustling out on straightening as the 1000m could be a tad short.
KING'S DRAMA is another Gangemi galloper who has also returned well. Drops back into a C2 midweek after running on from last in a Saturday Grad without getting room to build into his work. When he did he had the third fastest L200 on the day.
ANABALISTIC is a fresh mare - thats when she seems to do her best work. Can she run past those two gallopers?
BOSISTO was ultra impressive returning with a very handy win first up. Just marked him down the order as B7 could be tricky with some of these gallopers involved. Good little race.

LAST STYLEBENDER is really well placed into a C3. The last time he raced in this grade he won (carrying 58kg) and since then he has finished fourth in a 66+, fifth in a 60+ Grad, third  (beaten a head) in a 60+ Grad and most recently on a Heavy8 was on the worst part of the track and finished a distant fifth behind Niccimota. Should be in front for a long way. YAMASHITA’S GOLD has had two runs in WA and they’ve both been encouraging at Northam. 3kg claimer replaced by William Pike is always something that the market gravitates to and he’s afforded a gun map. KING’S DRAMA is a sit and sprint type who will be saved up for one last run at them. BOSISTO has come back in excellent order. Strong trial and strong fresh win.

bestBets.overview: CASSANDRA was strong debut winner where she beat a subsequent Saturday 3yo winner. She improves off that run, draws well and W Pike retains the ride. HOT CHIX LANE shook her maiden with a strong last start win. She will appreciate the rise in trip and just needs some luck from a sticky draw to go close. HEY TRUE BLUE attacks this fresh with the benefit of a soft trial. He has raced competitively in much better class of races than this previously. JAVELIN STRIKE was sound first-up.

raceTips.comment: CASSANDRA landed big bets on debut. She was backed to the exclusion of all others, sat rearward and powered down the centre of the Pinjarra track to gobble up now Saturday 3 year old winner Rocktex. It just screamed Champion Fillies and Grant & Alana Williams look like they’ll give her one more run in a C1 before she freshens in preparation for Ascot’s Summer Carnival. We’ve seen this blue print many a time and with only 55.5kg on her back expect that she’ll zap these. Anything better than even money = on. HOT CHIX LANE has been a work in progress across her career. Took her a while to hit top gear in her maiden but was doing her best over the last 100m. HEY TRUE BLUE has to contend with 61kg but did run fourth in both a Melvista Stakes and a WATC Derby. PERFUME PRINCESS is still a maiden but has a level of ability.

CASSANDRA is the lightly raced, progressive filly who was able to come out and take care of business first up over 1300m to beat home a nice one in Rocktex. She looks very hard to beat here.
HOT CHIX LANE won well last start but will likely be back and wide. If those are the lanes you want to be in by Race 6 it could be game on.
ONE TARGET has actually been racing well but afforded few favours at his past 3 starts.
RISING FAME a typically consistent Neville Parnham horse who can come across and sit on top of the pace.

bestBets.overview: IMPRESSIVE JEWEL should be ready at his fourth run back from a spell. She has run well in all her three starts this time in and W Pike goes on. BACK TO BONDI is rock hard fit and racing well. He will roll forward and give a strong kick. LIEN HYPHEN ran well first-up in a better class of race than this. She improves off that run and just needs some luck from her wide draw to play a part. THE NUN should be ready to fire at her third run back from a spell.

raceTips.comment:
Race you probably want each way. THE NUN can improve of her second up effort when quickly stepping up in trip. She showed a bit last campaign and meets a similar field third up.'
IMPRESSIVE JEWEL beat her home that day and Pike hops on board today. B1 with a cutaway makes me nervous jumping into the shorts though.
BACK TO BONDI has had two weeks of and comes from the same race while ROSIE CAN RUN will likely appreciate a run down the middle of the track.

BACK TO BONDI was on the second 7 day spin last start (third run in a fortnight) and he just looked a bit flat and a bit tired. Off the more traditional fortnight spacing here, into an open and even contest and into a race with less speed and pressure early he can bounce back. IMPRESSIVE JEWEL jumped $2.80 two back when Pike rode and she didn’t fire a shot. Much better last start when she looked the winner on straightening before being swamped. LIEN HYPHEN finished last prep with a pair of low graded staying wins and then resumed first-up, no trial at Belmont in a 60+ Grad where she ran out of her skin behind Silent Diva (placed in a 66+ on the weekend). If she reproduces that effort she’ll be right in this. ROSIE CAN RUN is a model of consistency and once she finds form she holds it really well.

bestBets.overview: RADIANT LIGHT has always showed ability and he is starting to put it all together and and attacks this off an all the way win at this track. CABLE ROCK is another on speeder with claims. He beat home Radiant Light in their last clash. SURROUND ME has ability and Pike rides. CLEANMEUP finds it hard to win but is always a chance at this level.

raceTips.comment: CLEANEMUP seems to go better the colder you ride her. She’s deep into a preparation (start 13) but this does look the weakest race she has seen since she was a fast finishing third to Belaura Star and Polyvanova in a C3 back in early August. 2.5L off Common Touch, Deel Her In (and Searchin’ Times), less than 2L off Champagne Crusader – it’s 60+ / 0MWLY form. There’s a good amount of tempo between Cable Rock and Radiant Light and Lieutenant Dunbar and provided they can make ground, she’ll be coming late. RADIANT LIGHT won well last week but was given a picnic in front (first 800m run 11L slower than average). CABLE ROCK beat him home the last time they met but this time around is drawn outside of him. SURROUND ME maps to get every mortal hope. But still not convinced on how good she is?

Fair bit of pace on paper here so looking for those that can close in and CLEANMEUP fits the bill for Brad Parnham who drops back into a not so strong 54+ to close out the card.
SURROUND ME will have her supporters, perhaps she didnt appreciate the heavy conditions at Northam last start.
CABLE ROCK has hit form being able to lead RADIANT LIGHT last start. Not convinced breezing by Race 8 will be a terrible place to be.
